forecast-period.text: A trough and cold front will move to the east of SA later Sunday. A high pressure system will move eastwards across waters to the south during Monday then over Victoria and the Tasman Sea on Tuesday. This high will extend a ridge westwards over SA ahead of a low pressure trough that is expected to move over the far west of SA during Wednesday. The trough will slip southeastwards over the Bight during Thursday.
For latest warnings go to www.bom.gov.au, subscribe to RSS feeds, call 1300 659 210* or listen for warnings on relevant TV and radio broadcasts.
* Calls to 1300 numbers cost around 27.5c incl. GST, higher from mobiles or public phones.

Possible morning fog over the Nullarbor Plain. Chance of an isolated light morning shower about the southern agricultural areas and a possible isolated thunderstorm near the northern border in the far northwest later. Maximum temperatures below average in the south but above average in the north. South to southeasterly winds, fresh in the northeast and near the coast during the afternoon.

Isolated light showers about the southern agricultural area. Chance of an isolated thunderstorm in the far northwest. Southwest to southeasterly winds extending across the west and south. Northeast to northwesterly winds in the northeast.

Cold at first with patchy frost about the agricultural area. Dry and mostly sunny day. Maximum temperatures above average in the north and west but slightly below average elsewhere. Southeast to northeasterly winds. Afternoon sea breezes near the coast.

text.p: Cold at first about eastern districts with with patchy frost. Isolated showers and possible thunderstorms developing in the far southwest and in the far northeast corner. Maximum temperatures above average. Southeast to northeasterly winds.

Isolated showers and possible thunderstorms in the far southwest and the chance of an isolated shower about southern coasts. Maximum temperatures above average. Northeast to northwesterly winds ahead of a southwest to southeasterly change in the far west.

Cumulative rainfall totals to the end of Thursday: less than 2 mm about the southern agricultural area and in the far southwest. Local falls of 2 to 5 mm are possible in the far southwest and near southern coasts.
